verdict.rationale: The evidence describes Postman building and serving MCP servers (the MCP Generator and an official Postman MCP server) and registering MCP servers with a Fabric gateway to share with a team. None of it shows Postman itself, for example Agent Mode, acting as an MCP client that connects to external servers and calls their tools. The gateway registration is adjacent infrastructure, and server-side MCP evidence belongs to a different story, so neither earns credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
